sentences.en: An exhibition was given in anticipation of the Queen's visit.
sentences.zh: 为了迎接女王的来访，举行了一场展览。

sentences.en: Today, we received your invitation to the exhibition with pleasure.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴收到了你们关于展览的邀请。

sentences.en: The university presents a photography exhibition with one hundred images.
sentences.zh: 这所大学举办了一次摄影展，展出了一百张照片。
